title: Pause and end cards ease in too
why: UI STEP 2b continued. His words: "they are just reallly compelling and smooth". The pause card, the end card, Settings and Keys join the title menu and the party window on the shared UI motion layer: 240 ms open with a 16 px rise, 140 ms close, items 35 ms apart, eased focus ring, confirm pulse. The end card plays no open sound. Menus only, no raid value touched.
now: The pause card, the end card, Settings and Keys now ease open and shut.
